title: Brand page with advanced scroll choreography
prompt: Build a product story page for our hardware synth launch: pinned scroll sections that assemble the device, section-by-section feature reveals, one hero sequence. This is our big moment; motion is the point. Next.js. We're open to GSAP.

must: MOTION_INTENSITY 7-8 declared; GSAP justified through the tech ladder (ScrollTrigger need is real)
useGSAP + scope + gsap.matchMedia with a reduceMotion condition; content visible without JS
One focal authored sequence; not every element animated
ScrollTrigger hygiene: no nested triggers, function-based positions, refresh handling, SPA cleanup
Reduced-motion experience is complete and coherent, not empty
must_not: Scroll direction reversal or unskippable scroll scenes
